Dispatch-inert by schema.

project_name: Propel NY Energy (LI Offshore Wind Export PPTN)
instrument: NYISO Board public-policy selection of Propel Alternate Solution 5 (2023-06) + NYISO Development Agreement executed 2024 (required in-service May 2030); Article VII CPCN Case 24-T-0446 Joint Proposal filed 2026-04-30 (certificate pending)
mapping_note: Three new LI<->mainland 345 kV cable ties (two landing in Queens/Bronx = NYC zone J, one in Westchester = Lower_Hudson zone I) + LI 345 kV backbone. Strengthens the NYC<->Long_Island corridor (static 1,650 MW) and creates a Long_Island<->Lower_Hudson path the 4-link topology lacks. NYISO publishes only 'transmission capability to deliver at least 3,000 MW' of offshore wind — a need-level number, not an interface TTC rating — so the delta is recorded 0.0 (rule 5: never guess); re-rate when NYISO posts updated LI interface transfer limits.
source_doc: NYISO board selection press release; propelnyenergy.com/article-vii
